extension.summary: Browse your TV library by airing status
Explora tu biblioteca de series por estado de emisión
extension.description: Lists the TV series in your Kodi library with their airing status (Ended, Cancelled, Continuing...), lets you filter by status - including shows that have finished airing for good - and can refresh the stored statuses from TMDB.

Lista las series de tu biblioteca de Kodi con su estado de emisión (Finalizada, Cancelada, En emisión...), permite filtrar por estado -incluidas las series que ya no emitirán nunca- y puede actualizar los estados guardados consultando TMDB.
